name: file_metadata
description: Read AND edit metadata of ANY file inside the working folder. action=read (default) extracts everything it can — base facts for any file (name, size, mime, modified time, sha256) plus image details (format, dimensions, EXIF tags, PNG text) plus audio/video duration when ffmpeg exists — and returns it normally. action=set writes the given tags into a COPY (<name>.meta.<ext>, the original is never touched): EXIF for JPEG/TIFF, text chunks for PNG. Other file kinds cannot carry edited tags and are rejected for set.

action.description: read: extract all metadata. set: write tags (needs tags) into a .meta copy.

tags.description: JSON object of tags for action=set, e.g. {"Artist": "Omar", "Copyright": "2026"}. Common EXIF names (ImageDescription, Artist, Copyright, Software, DateTime) or numeric ids ("271"); PNG keys are stored verbatim. Max 20 tags.
